purpose: Test whether a strict-PIT relative macro turning point predicts the next monthly relative 2Y repricing before any FX outcome is joined.

result_blind_base.reason: Reuse the already-certified G4USD strict-PIT macro/rates plumbing from before the prior alignment economic result.

macro_inputs.inflation: existing certified strict-PIT inflation series only
macro_inputs.labour: existing certified strict-PIT unemployment series only
macro_inputs.official_nonpublication: skip as a non-observation; do not synthesize a value

macro_direction.NO_SIGNAL: components disagree, either component is exactly zero, or PIT history is insufficient

monthly_grid.source: the frozen G4USD monthly reference/as-of grid already used in PR #122
monthly_grid.signal_time: macro direction is computed using only releases PIT-known at the current monthly as-of date
monthly_grid.rates_outcome: the next frozen monthly observation's change in local-minus-USD 2Y differential
monthly_grid.reason: Force macro information to precede the primary rates outcome and avoid contemporaneous classification.

historical_validation.split: chronological 60/40 within each currency after eligible macro signals are constructed
historical_validation.in_sample_role: coverage and descriptive diagnostics only; cannot change rules

interpretation_policy.pass: Mechanism candidate only: macro turning points appear to precede coherent relative front-end repricing; a separate frozen FX test is then allowed.
interpretation_policy.fail: Do not proceed to FX under this hypothesis and do not rescue by changing weights, horizons, components, thresholds, or currencies.
